name: Western Adriatic Current
scope: Po-region offshore approach to western Otranto along the Italian Adriatic coast. Regional surface route, not the whole vertically structured western Adriatic circulation. Excludes eastern boundary inflow, cross-basin gyre circuits, Gulf of Manfredonia recirculation, deep dense-water pathways and downstream Ionian continuation.
layer: Near-surface coastal corridor. No bottom/slope dense-water branch or fixed-depth velocity core reconstructed.
time_convention: Regional surface naming convention informed by 1990-2007 drifter context and 2018 regional synthesis. Not a simultaneous drifter trajectory, annual mean axis or route valid during every wind reversal.
source_locator: Poulain and Hariri (2013), section 3, printed p. 716: southeastward Italian-coast WAC exits western Otranto. Sections 2.1-2.2 and figure 1: 1990-2007 near-surface drifters and distinct outflow section; 40 N is a basin residence-time boundary, not a current endpoint.
source_citation: Poulain and Hariri (2013), Transit and residence times in the Adriatic Sea surface as derived from drifter data and Lagrangian numerical simulations, Ocean Science 9, 713-720, doi:10.5194/os-9-713-2013.

supporting_sources.citation: Sciascia et al. (2018), Linking sardine recruitment in coastal areas to ocean currents using surface drifters and HF radar: a case study in the Gulf of Manfredonia, Adriatic Sea, doi:10.5194/os-14-1461-2018.
supporting_sources.locator: Section 2.1: buoyant Po-forced WAC along Italian coast and wind modulation; section 2.2: separate Gulf of Manfredonia setting.
supporting_sources.role: Surface branch identity and regional origin; local HF radar/larval paths do not define the full current axis.

coordinate_selection: OSW selects every offshore vertex, the Po-region start and western Otranto terminal gates at 40.4 N and 40.0 N. These are regional bookkeeping gates, not observed named-flow termination bounds. Source outflow-section coordinates in a rotated local frame are not silently reinterpreted as longitude/latitude; no drifter tracks or mean vectors digitized. Offsets test only selected editorial geography.

alternative_routes.interpretation: Alternative OSW southern Otranto approach gate; 40 N source basin boundary does not prove current termination.

scenario_rule: Two regional Otranto gate choices crossed with longitude and independent endpoint latitude offsets of -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 54 editorial scenarios, not empirical endpoint uncertainty.
method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 54 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.

nasa_movie_context.interpretation: Editorial reference-route/crop display overlap only; not physical current identification or dated event matching. Fraction measures equirectangular display line, not physical kilometres.
